about.h1: Welcome to Waset Travel — Your Gateway to Authentic Egypt
about.p: At Waset Travel, we believe that travel is more than just visiting iconic sights—it is about creating deep, unforgettable connections with history, culture, and nature. Based in Egypt, we specialize in crafting personalized, high-quality travel experiences for adventurers, history enthusiasts, and seekers of off-the-beaten-path journeys.
about.p2: From the majestic Pyramids of Giza and the monumental temples of Luxor and Aswan, to hidden archaeological gems and serene local landscapes, we curate itineraries designed around your preferences. Whether you want to explore world-famous ancient landmarks or discover quiet, lesser-known treasures across Egypt, we ensure every detail of your journey is seamless, inspiring, and memorable.
about.liText: You design your ideal program, and we bring it to life with precision and care.
about.li2Text: We guide you to both world-renowned wonders and unique, untouched destinations off the main tourist trail.
about.li3Text: Our experienced team provides authentic historical context, deep local insights, and top-tier hospitality.
about.li4Text: From private transportation to expert guide services, we handle every detail so you can travel worry-free.
about.p3: To bridge cultures and share the rich heritage of Egypt with travelers from around the globe, delivering extraordinary journeys built on trust, authenticity, and personalized service.
about.p4: From the majestic Pyramids of Giza and the monumental temples of Luxor and Aswan, to hidden archaeological gems and serene local landscapes, we curate itineraries designed around your preferences. Whether you want to explore world-famous ancient landmarks or discover quiet, lesser-known treasures across Egypt, we ensure every detail of your journey is seamless, inspiring, and memorable.
about.p5: Let’s craft an itinerary that feels personal, elegant, and effortless.

cancellationPolicy.title: Payment and Cancellation Policy
cancellationPolicy.cancellationText: Cancellation requests must be sent in writing via email to provide Waset Travel with official confirmation.
cancellationPolicy.note: Note: For any cancellation, a 6% bank transaction fee will be charged on the deposit paid.
cancellationPolicy.refundsText: Refunds will be processed using the same payment method within 14 working days. No refunds for no-shows.
cancellationPolicy.accommodationText: Prices are based on twin sharing. Single rooms available with supplementary rate. Hotels may be substituted with similar quality.
cancellationPolicy.responsibilityText: Waset Travel acts only as an agent. We assume no liability for injury, illness, damage, loss, accident, delay, or irregularity caused by:
responsibilityList: Weather, acts of God, force majeure
Delays or cancellations by hotels, carriers, restaurants
cancellationPolicy.specialRequestsText: Requests must be made at booking. We try to satisfy but cannot guarantee fulfillment. Bookings cannot be conditional on requests.
cancellationPolicy.tippingText: Tipping is customary to express satisfaction. Entirely at your discretion.
cancellationPolicy.complaintsText: Notify Waset Travel immediately for issues. If unresolved, contact Egyptian Travel Agent Association or Ministry of Tourism.
cancellationPolicy.acceptanceText: Payment of deposit/final payment indicates acceptance of all terms and conditions.
